    Graph forms and patterns #

    For a graph form (off-diagonal coefficients 0 or -1), B(u, u) = 2 Σ u_v² - Σ_v u_v Σ_{w ~ v} u_w (B_self_graph). For u ≥ 0 the neighbour sums can be replaced by sums over any subsets of the neighbours (B_self_le_pattern). A nonempty set in which every point has two neighbours gives q(1_S) ≤ 0 (val_indicator_le).
